card.name: Words continuing a clinical phrase
card.fires_on: Words that sit mid-phrase in drug-label text and are about to be followed by a time period, a parenthetical, or a verb. Examples are 'period' after observation, 'hours' after a number, '(' after an event name, and 'one' ending dexamethasone.

modes.label: Time-period words
modes.description: Words like period, hours, or -up that name a span of time in monitoring or dosing text.
